summary: Analyse customer value, retention and profitability with Python. Practise RFM, cohort and CLV methods. Explore the course outline.
lede: Customer analytics with Python helps customer insight analysts, CRM specialists and commercial managers measure customer value and retention. The work includes checking and preparing records in pandas, defining customer metrics, calculating RFM segments and cohort retention, estimating customer lifetime value from stated assumptions, and reporting findings with charts. It also addresses data limitations and cautions against treating observed patterns as proof of cause.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with customer transactions, retention measures or CRM decisions and need to analyse customer-level evidence in Python.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of Python fundamentals and basic tabular data handling is expected. Coding is required for the exercises. Bring a laptop with Python and Jupyter installed; no programming beyond the course exercises is required.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
